Start Frame
locks 2D style into the video
Why this matters
Upload the confirmed image for this scene as the Start Frame. Kling uses it as the exact first frame of your video and extends it into motion — keeping the 2D character style locked throughout the clip.
Without a Start Frame, Kling generates the opening frame from text only — your character may appear photorealistic or look inconsistent with the image you generated.

⚙ Settings & API Keys
xAI (Grok) API Key REQUIRED
Writes the script, segments it, classifies scenes and drafts image/video prompts. Get yours at console.x.ai → API Keys. Calls go directly from your browser to api.x.ai.
✓ Key saved for this session
Advanced: Grok model IDs
Writer = script (default grok-4.7). Fast = segmentation, classification, scene prompts (default grok-4.3). Leave blank for defaults.
✓ Models saved
ElevenLabs API Key REQUIRED
Required for voiceover generation. Get yours at elevenlabs.io → Profile → API Key. Permission needed: Text to Speech → Access.
✓ Key saved for this session
fal.ai API Key REQUIRED
Used for Kling image and video generation. Get yours at fal.ai → Dashboard → API Keys.
✓ Key saved for this session
OpenAI API Key optional
Used for the ✨ Fix Text with GPT Image step on image results. Corrects garbled or misspelled text on Kling images while keeping the scene identical. Get yours at platform.openai.com → API Keys. Cost: ~$0.05 per enhancement.
✓ OpenAI key saved for this session
Grok Bot render service optional
Lets 🚀 Send to Grok for final edit upload the finished scenes to Grok Bot, which plans the edit and renders the MP4 for review here. Paste the service URL and access token Grok Bot gave you. Both stay in this browser session only.
✓ Render service saved for this session
